title: Step 7 - routes with method patterns and path values
intro: `api` holds the store, and its methods are the handlers.
`routes` registers them on an `http.ServeMux` and returns
Since Go 1.22 a pattern can start with a method:
`"GET /bookmarks"` matches only GET. For any other
method on that path the mux answers 405 by itself.
`{id}` is a wildcard: it matches one path segment, and
`strconv.Atoi` turns it into an int, and its error means
the client sent something else: that is a 400. A number
the store doesn't have is a 404.
